Lachmidevī
or Lakhimādevī. wife of Candra Siṃha, younger brother of Bhairava Siṃhadeva of the Kāmeśvara dynasty of Mithilā. Patronized by her, Miśāru Miśra ascribed his works Padārthacandrikā on ny-vaiś. system, (see L. 2901) an. Vivādacandra to her.
See Kane, HDS. I. ii. p. 843. ; also JASB. NS. XI (1915) 271. 404.
